rationale: Excluded (E07 - wrong service; also fails C3 doctrinal essay without empirical data). This 1950 law review article examines legal issues surrounding river-basin water resource capture and land/agricultural irrigation distribution in California's Central Valley Project (citing United States v. Gerlach Live Stock Co.), rather than household or community water or sanitation service access, and presents doctrinal legal analysis rather than empirical evidence.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the article discusses legal implications of a water project under the literal reading of Criterion 2, it is excluded under both readings because it concerns macro-scale river-basin resource development and land irrigation rather than household or community water/sanitation service access (C1/C4) and is a doctrinal legal essay lacking empirical primary evidence (C3).
